limitations: Uniform 720x28 simultaneous rays at 10 Hz; not a non-repetitive Livox scan.
All per-point offsets are zero: the entire rendered scan is one snapshot. No invented motion distortion or timing.
40 m fixed range, Gaussian 2 cm noise; no reflectivity-dependent range, weather, interference or multiple returns.
IMU uses SI acceleration at the approximate lidar origin, not the physical MID-360 internal IMU lever arm/noise model.
Sensor housing is visual only; vehicle mass, inertia and actuator configuration are unchanged.
Gazebo geometry truth TF and schematic vehicle model are visualization-only; never localization or control input.
